Sandeep Kumar vs State Of Haryana And Another on 20 April,
2024
 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:053347
 N.C. No.2024:PHHC:053347
 In The High Court Of Punjab & Haryana 
 At Chandigarh 
227
 Crm-M-40237-2023 (O&M) 
 Date of decision: 20.04.2024
Sandeep Kumar
 ....Petitioner(s)
 Versus
State Of Haryana And Another
 ...Respondent(s)
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjiv Berry 
Present : Mr. Mohan Singh Chauhan, Advocate for the petitioner(s).
 Mr. Surender Singh, Aag Haryana. 
 * * * **
Sanjiv Berry. J. (Oral) 
The present petition has been preferred by the petitioner under Section 482 CrPC seeking direction to learned trial Court for deciding the application dated 20.02.2023 (Annexure P-4) filed by the petitioner in Complaint Case No.COMA/773/2021 dated 13.08.2021 titled as 'State through Food Safety Officer versus Sandeep Kumar'.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he has only limited prayer in the instant petition to the effect that the petitioner had moved an application dated 20.02.2023 (Annexure P-4) in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ambala in Criminal Complaint No. COMA/773/2021 but till date the same has not been decided and the next date of hearing is 23.04.2024. He submits that for the purpose of this petition, the petitioner will be satisfied if appropriate directions are given to learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ambala to decide the application within specific time frame so that the petitioner may not suffer irreparable loss and injury. 
3. Considering the limited prayer made by learned counsel for the 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:053347 N.C. No.2024:PHHC:053347 CRM-M-40237-2023 (O&M) -2- petitioner,
without commenting on the merits thereof, the present petition is disposed of with direction to learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ambala to consider and dispose of the application dated Sandeep Kumar vs State Of Haryana And Another on 20 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67045004/
1 20.02.2023 (Annexure P-4) moved by the petitioner in the aforesaid complaint case in accordance with law in an expeditious manner, preferably within a period of 03 months from the next date of hearing i.e. 23.04.2024.
4. Disposed of accordingly.
 (SANJIV BERRY)
 JUDGE 20.04.2024 S.Sharma(syr)
